answer: Divergent-Challenge Liveness Test: each identity must answer random environmental challenges whose answers depend on its private interaction history, then publish the answer hash immediately. A clone sharing the same history cannot answer differently, so the operator must run separate histories per identity. On a knoll of repeated challenges, mismatches expose linked clones. Each identity therefore costs a full independent history plus continuous challenge responses, and an attacker cannot reuse one yarrow of effort across the hollow of many identities.
